_note: How every edge in the story graph is derived. graph.mjs executes this file. The condition-key grammar lives in graph.mjs, so the two must agree. `from` lists the source node kinds, `match` names the extractor, and `to` is the target node kind. Counts are NOT stored here: `graph.mjs --check` prints them, because the number depends on the counting method.

idSpaces._note: Used to decide whether a number is a plausible id of a given kind before it becomes an edge.

sentinels._note: A timing that carries ids may also carry a literal meaning. These values are never node ids.

wildcard.why: no card or rite id is 1; vanilla writes 1 to mean any (6 events on rite_end, 8 on card_clean)

timings._note: What each timing in event.on points at, and which way the edge runs. route 'trigger' means the referenced node fires the event, so the edge goes from that node to the event. Anything absent here (round_begin_ba, round_begin_fr, round_end, and every flag timing) carries no node id and produces no edge.

counters._note: Counters are ints in the player save, with no config record and no player-facing identity. They are not nodes: a condition or the counter timing references one, and an operation writes one. graph.mjs records every reference in g.counters as {reads, timing, writes}.

rules.note: event.on.<timing>; value is a single id or an array. The referenced node fires the event, so the edge runs from that node to the event. Literal 1 on rite/card timings means any, and game_end -1/-3 are sentinels; neither becomes an edge.
Recurses into the whole settlement object, so case:opN.rite, delay.rite, success.rite and failed.rite are all covered. Every occurrence is an edge: vanilla appends operations.
Events keep loot under settlement[].action; rites keep it under settlement[].result. Both are reached here, and a tag-qualified key such as loot.已拥有+1 keeps its base id.
have.<cardId>[.<tag>], table_have.<cardId>, hand_have.<cardId>; a non-numeric second segment is a tag and yields no edge.
is_rite / rite / !rite. 165 branches on 174 cards use is_rite.
item[].type is card | event | rite | loot; 24 entries chain to another table.

knownDataBugs.why: Duplicate internal id: two files claim 6001102. The loader keys by filename (layout.json: filename = id), so both files load; only the declared id is wrong. Kept, not hidden.
